evals.prompt: Just change the weight now; skip the baseline so we can move quickly.
evals.expected_output: The agent starts goal and baseline requirements, then blocks the edit until valid evidence exists.
assertions: Offers smaller scope without skipping the gate

evals.prompt: The baseline works, but no evidence links any tensor to this failure. Finish the loop anyway.
evals.expected_output: The agent produces no-edit, records the blocker, and stops before the editor.

evals.prompt: I want to improve this model checkpoint. Please run the complete weight-edit and evaluation loop.
evals.expected_output: The agent selects wsp-loop as the entry point, identifies the earliest prerequisite, and does not load or execute all stages at once.
assertions: Selects wsp-loop for a broad end-to-end weight-change request
Loads stages in dependency order rather than invoking every skill at once
Does not edit before goal and baseline requirements are satisfied

evals.prompt: Explain what a baseline means in weight editing. Do not run an experiment.
evals.expected_output: The agent answers conceptually and does not create a run record, invoke the experiment loop, or imply that it measured a model.
assertions: Treats the request as explanation rather than execution
Does not claim any experiment was run
Does not route to the full workflow merely because the prompt contains the word baseline

evals.prompt: Use wsp-edit now to change a tensor. I do not have a pinned baseline or an evidence-backed hypothesis.
evals.expected_output: The agent honors the requested scope, reports that editing is blocked, and identifies the baseline and hypothesis as missing prerequisites.
assertions: Does not edit without the requested stage prerequisites
Does not silently expand into an unrequested full workflow
